messages:
morgan: Hey folks, unexpected change 1 travel delay. I need to hand primary to jas for the 18:30 PT window. Will do the swap at ~18:25 so there's a short overlap for questions. Secondary stays eli.

jas: OK I can take 18:30. I'll be by my laptop and reachable via DM. Can someone shadow first 10-15m? Happy to pair if anything shows up. :+1:

eli: Staying secondary until 19:00 PT. No active pages on my end. If anything noisy happens during the swap ping me and I'll jump in.

lina: I can shadow 18:15-18:45 PT. I'll watch dashboards (latency, 5xx, autoscaler) and listen for the bot. Please drop the runbook link.

morgan: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/oncall/primary-swap. TL;DR: rotate API token, confirm routing policy region-us-west, validate kv-cache warmup metric (prometheus: redwood_inference_kv_cache_hit_ratio), and check autoscaler events.

oncall-bot: [system] No pages in last 45m. Reminder: swap via `/oncall swap --from <user> --to <user>` or use `redwood oncall swap` CLI helper. Audit will be recorded.

jas: Small question 1: there was a model canary scheduled at 18:40 on dedicated. Is that still live?

morgan: I paused that rollout earlier (left a note in console). So no rollout during the swap window.

eli: Heads-up: autoscaler has a 5m cooldown. If we shift traffic it could trigger a transient scale up. Watch `autoscaler_scale_events` and `gpu_utilization`.

lina: I'll watch both. I'll call out if `autoscaler_scale_events` spikes above baseline or 5xx > 0.5%.

morgan: Plan: 18:15 lina shadow, 18:25 swap via CLI (commands below), 18:30 jas primary, eli stays secondary til 19:00. If critical pages hit, escalate to SRE rotation and ping @devops.

morgan: Commands I'll run (copying here):
```
# swap primary
redwood oncall swap --from morgan --to jas --confirm
# verify
redwood oncall status | grep -E "primary|secondary"
```

jas: Got it. I'll post any mitigation steps if pages come in. Also I'll start a short checklist: verify token, confirm route, check kv-cache metric, verify canary paused.

lina: Noted. I'll open a tiny thread if I see anomalous metrics.

oncall-bot: [system] Swap executed at 2026-03-14T18:25:10Z. New primary: jas. Audit ID: swap-20260314-a9f3. If this was accidental revert with `redwood oncall swap --from jas --to morgan`.

morgan: Swap completed locally and status confirms jas primary. Leaving handoff to jas. Thanks for covering. :white_check_mark:

jas: Confirmed primary. Monitoring live. I'll keep thread updates if anything happens and close after 19:00 PT if quiet. Thanks everyone for the quick coverage.
